selection: Most recent observation IDs, first licensed primary photo, at most one observation per observer per class; skip detected related images. No model predictions used.
limits: Observation dates and labels are contributor supplied. This is a small external audit, not a representative deployment benchmark.
visual_eligibility_rule: Before predictions: exclude isolated skeletal remains, teeth, footprints and dung; retain blurry, distant, low-light, partly occluded and otherwise difficult animal photos. No replacement or model-driven exclusion. Report both all observations and eligible animal photographs.
